description.zh:
WAF实例ID。

> 您可以通过调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)接口查看您当前WAF实例ID。
description.en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> Call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to view your current WAF instance ID.

description.zh: 需要管理的WAF成员账号ID列表。单次最多可添加 10 个成员账号。
description.en: The Alibaba Cloud account IDs of the members that you want to add. You can add up to 10 members at the same time.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region of the WAF instance. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: The Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: Outside the Chinese mainland.
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

description.zh: 请求源IP。无需填写，系统自动获取。
description.en: The source IP address of the request. The system automatically obtains the value of this parameter.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi create-member-accounts --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id waf_cdnsdf30000 --source-ip 1.1.X.X --member-account-ids 139000000000055 --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
